summary.en: Auditable omics reanalysis, single-cell graph clustering and local metabolomics workflows.
summary.zh: 可审计组学重分析、单细胞图聚类与本地代谢组工作流。

en: Three papers explore reproducible data reuse and analysis: agent-supported reanalysis, spectral filters for single-cell clustering, and an integrated R metabolomics workflow.

The most useful next step is to examine intervention logging and graph-filter ablations. Coverage is limited to accessible publisher and indexed records; some online-first feeds and full texts were unavailable.
zh: 本日介绍三项面向数据复用与分析的软件研究：智能体辅助重分析、单细胞聚类的谱图滤波，以及整合式 R 代谢组工作流。
值得深入的是人工干预记录与图滤波消融设计。本次依据可访问的出版社和索引记录筛选，部分在线先行目录及全文未能读取。

papers.title: Omics data discovery agents: Agent-supported retrieval, reanalysis, and synthesis of published omics data

publication_status.zh: 正式论文；已有早期预印本

read_scope.en: Publisher main text; no independent reproduction
read_scope.zh: 已读出版社正文；未独立复现

commentary.zh: ODDA 将文献参数提取、数据定位和容器化重分析连接起来，并记录来源与人工干预，适合借鉴其可审计的流程设计。作者完成了 5 项重分析（其中 1 项 DDA、2 项 DIA），但每项均需人工指导或流程调整，不能据此推断无人值守成功率；大规模文献提取也尚无独立准确率基准。
commentary.en: ODDA connects parameter extraction, data retrieval and containerized reanalysis with provenance and intervention records, offering a useful design for auditable workflows. The authors completed five reanalyses, including one DDA and two DIA studies, but every case needed human guidance or workflow accommodations; these demonstrations do not establish unattended success rates, and corpus-scale extraction lacks an independent accuracy benchmark.

papers.title: scProfiterole: Clustering of Single-Cell Proteomic Data Using Graph Contrastive Learning via Spectral Filters

publication_status.en: Online-first journal article; earlier preprint available
publication_status.zh: 期刊在线先行论文；已有早期预印本

read_scope.en: Journal abstract and selected earlier-preprint Methods/Results; journal full text and supplements not verified
read_scope.zh: 已读期刊摘要及早期预印本部分方法与结果；未核验期刊全文与补充材料

commentary.zh: scProfiterole 用 Arnoldi 正交化稳定谱图滤波器的多项式插值，并学习滤波系数，以改善单细胞蛋白组相似图上的对比学习与聚类。早期预印本在 SCoPE2 及合并的 N2/nanoPOTS 数据上比较滤波器和聚类基线，支持借鉴其初始化与消融设计；样本类型有限，构图依赖上游处理，不能把聚类改善等同于缺失值恢复或广泛跨平台泛化。
commentary.en: scProfiterole stabilizes polynomial interpolation of spectral graph filters through Arnoldi orthonormalization and learns filter coefficients for contrastive clustering of single-cell proteomics. The earlier preprint compares filters and clustering baselines on SCoPE2 and combined N2/nanoPOTS data, making its initialization and ablation design useful; limited cell types and dependence on upstream graph construction constrain generalization, and better clustering does not establish missing-value recovery.

papers.title: mums2: an R package for database-dependent and -independent analysis of untargeted metabolomics data

read_scope.en: Publisher main text and project documentation; software not run
read_scope.zh: 已读出版社正文及项目文档；未运行软件

commentary.zh: mums2 在本地 R 工作流中整合特征质控、谱库匹配、分子式预测和谱图聚类，将特征组织为操作性代谢组单元（OMU）以连接生态统计。作者报告 267 个样本在 14 线程下约需 7.6 分钟和 6 GB 内存；这是单一运行示例而非全面基准，OMU 也不等于已确认的化合物，价值主要在模块整合与数据接口。
commentary.en: mums2 integrates feature QC, library matching, formula prediction and spectral clustering in a local R workflow, organizing features into operational metabolomic units (OMUs) for ecological analysis. The authors report 7.6 minutes and 6 GB RAM for 267 samples on 14 threads; this is a runtime example, not a comprehensive benchmark, and OMUs are not confirmed compounds. Its main value lies in modular integration and interoperable data structures.
